career_paths.title: Data Analyst
career_paths.summary: Extracts, cleans, models, and analyzes operational and customer data using SQL, Excel, and BI tools to answer critical business questions and build executive dashboards.
career_paths.summary_hi: कंपनी के डेटा को SQL, Excel और BI टूल्स से प्रोसेस करके बिजनेस की समस्याओं को हल करना और निर्णय लेने के लिए रिपोर्ट्स और डैशबोर्ड बनाना।
day_to_day: Write SQL queries to join and aggregate data from cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL).
Build, test, and maintain interactive business dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to investigate drop-offs in customer conversion or revenue leaks.
Collaborate with marketing, operations, and product managers to define tracking metrics and KPIs.
Translate raw query results into concise executive slides with actionable recommendations.
career_paths.background_applicability: Open to both non-technical and technical backgrounds. Candidates from commerce, arts, customer support, operations, and sales successfully transition by mastering structured problem solving, SQL, and data visualization.

transferable_skills.skill: Ledger reconciliation translates directly to SQL data validation and financial metric logic.
Direct customer empathy helps spot user churn patterns and define meaningful retention metrics.
Process mindset helps trace data quality issues from source capture to final report.
Narrative clarity turns complex numbers into compelling executive presentations.

portfolio_projects.title: E-Commerce Customer Retention & Cohort Churn Dashboard
portfolio_projects.scenario: Analyzed 120,000 transaction records using SQL and Power BI to identify a 24% month-over-month drop in repeat purchases.

portfolio_projects.title: Retail Regional Profitability & Discount Optimization
portfolio_projects.scenario: Built an interactive Tableau workbook uncovering how unauthorized regional discounts eroded margins by $140,000.

career_paths.entry_requirements: Bachelor's degree in any discipline (technical or non-technical). Employers value a demonstrable portfolio of 2-3 verified projects over formal certifications.
career_paths.common_barriers: Common barriers include getting overwhelmed by trying to learn machine learning too early, poor query optimization habits, and inability to explain business impact behind charts.

phases.focus: Computer foundations, Terminal, Advanced Excel & Business Problem Framing
Core SQL: Filtering, Joins, Aggregations & Database Normalization
Advanced SQL: Window Functions, CTEs, and Power BI / Tableau Modeling
Python for EDA (Pandas) & First End-to-End Portfolio Project
Second Portfolio Project, ATS Resume Engineering & Mock SQL Interviews

career_paths.pay_variation_factors: Pay varies heavily by company tier: Global Capability Centers (GCCs) and product startups pay significantly higher than traditional domestic IT service firms. Demonstrating production SQL optimization and business storytelling commands an immediate premium.

career_paths.title: Business Analyst
career_paths.summary: Bridges the gap between business stakeholders and technical engineering teams. Specializes in requirement elicitation, process mapping (BPMN), gap analysis, and agile user stories.
career_paths.summary_hi: बिजनेस मैनेजमेंट और टेक्निकल टीम के बीच की कड़ी। कंपनियों की कार्यप्रणाली सुधारना, रिक्वायरमेंट्स समझना और नए सॉफ्टवेयर सॉल्यूशंस का रोडमैप बनाना।
day_to_day: Facilitate stakeholder discovery sessions and client workshops to uncover operational bottlenecks.
Document Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and functional specifications for engineering.
Map 'As-Is' vs 'To-Be' business workflows using standard BPMN 2.0 notation in Lucidchart or Miro.
Author epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira with sprint planning teams.
Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm deployed features match business objectives.
career_paths.background_applicability: Highly accessible to non-technical professionals. Exceptional communication, empathy, and organizational skills make candidates from sales, operations, HR, banking, and management strong contenders.

transferable_skills.skill: Managing deadlines, client follow-ups, and milestone tracking.
Understanding end-user frustration directly informs user story acceptance criteria.
Workflow mapping and eliminating non-value-add steps.

portfolio_projects.title: Hospital ER Patient Triage Optimization (BPMN 2.0)
portfolio_projects.scenario: Mapped patient intake workflows for a regional hospital, modeling a 42% reduction in non-emergency wait times through digital pre-triage.

portfolio_projects.title: Fintech Mobile Loan Application Feature Specification
portfolio_projects.scenario: Authored 14 detailed user stories in Jira with Gherkin acceptance criteria (Given-When-Then) for paperless KYC onboarding.

career_paths.entry_requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, or Humanities. ECBA or CCBA credentials help but are not mandatory when a strong requirement portfolio is presented.
career_paths.common_barriers: Writing vague requirements that cause engineering rework; failing to challenge unrealistic stakeholder demands; lack of understanding of agile team ceremonies.

phases.focus: Data & Business foundations, Stakeholder interview frameworks, SMART problem definition
BPMN 2.0 process modeling, As-Is vs To-Be redesign, Bottleneck quantification
Agile Scrum, Jira story writing, Acceptance criteria, BRD/FRD templates
Basic SQL for data validation, UAT test execution, Portfolio project & mock interviews

career_paths.title: Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst
career_paths.summary: Architects scalable reporting data models, automated semantic layers, and real-time enterprise dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, and dimensional data modeling (Star Schema).
career_paths.summary_hi: कंपनी के लिए एंटरप्राइज डैशबोर्ड और डेटा मॉडल्स बनाना। Power BI, Tableau और Looker के जरिए विभिन्न विभागों को ऑटोमेटेड रिपोर्ट्स देना।
day_to_day: Design Star Schema dimensional models (Fact and Dimension tables) in Power BI or Snowflake.
Write complex DAX formulas (CALCULATE, FILTER, time intelligence) or Tableau Level-of-Detail (LOD) calcs.
Automate data refresh pipelines, row-level security (RLS), and workspace governance.
Conduct query performance tuning (analyzing VertiPaq memory compression and query plans).
Collaborate with data engineers to certify semantic metrics across corporate reporting.
career_paths.background_applicability: Open to both non-tech and technical learners. Analysts with strong spreadsheet modeling instincts quickly pick up dimensional relationships and DAX logic.

transferable_skills.skill: Experience with complex nested Excel formulas accelerates DAX mastery.
Visual hierarchy and gestalt principles create highly adopted, readable dashboards.

portfolio_projects.title: Enterprise Global Sales Intelligence Suite (Power BI)
portfolio_projects.scenario: Modeled a 6-dimension Star Schema connecting FactSales to DimDate, DimProduct, and DimCustomer, supporting 12 DAX time-intelligence metrics.

career_paths.entry_requirements: Bachelor's degree in any quantitative or business discipline. Demonstrable mastery of dimensional modeling and DAX/LOD measures via published public dashboard portfolios (NovyPro / Tableau Public).
career_paths.common_barriers: Treating Power BI as just a visual tool without learning dimensional modeling; writing inefficient DAX that causes visual timeouts; failing to implement data refresh security.

phases.focus: Foundations, Excel Data Model, Power Query & Pivot Tables
SQL Joins, Views, Aggregations, and Dimensional Modeling concepts
Power BI Desktop: Star Schema architecture, Relationships, Cardinality & Filter Propagation
DAX in depth: Row vs Filter Context, CALCULATE, Time Intelligence, Row-Level Security
Tableau Public portfolio publication, Performance tuning & Mock Technical Interviews

US.notes: Looker and Tableau developers in financial centers and cloud firms lead compensation.

UK.notes: High demand across retail, healthcare NHS trusts, and banking.

EU.notes: Power BI and Snowflake stack dominates German manufacturing and Dutch logistics.

career_paths.pay_variation_factors: Specialists who can bridge semantic layers in dbt and optimize DAX VertiPaq performance earn 25% more than visual-only dashboard builders.

career_paths.title: Product Analyst
career_paths.summary: Works hand-in-hand with Product Managers (PMs) to understand user behavior, run A/B experiment analyses, map feature adoption funnels, and optimize retention.
career_paths.summary_hi: सॉफ्टवेयर और ऍप्स की ग्रोथ के लिए काम करना। यूजर्स किस फीचर को पसंद कर रहे हैं, कहाँ ऍप छोड़ रहे हैं, और A/B टेस्टिंग का क्या असर पड़ा, इसका विश्लेषण करना।
day_to_day: Design and evaluate A/B experiments: sample size estimation, p-values, minimum detectable effect (MDE).
Analyze behavioral telemetry using event-tracking tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Google Analytics 4).
Build retention cohort curves and user conversion funnel models in SQL.
Conduct feature adoption post-mortems to discover which updates drove engagement.
Partner with PMs and designers to prioritize quarterly product feature roadmaps.
career_paths.background_applicability: Welcomes non-technical learners with high product curiosity. Professionals from UI/UX design, marketing, game design, and customer success make exceptional product analysts.

transferable_skills.skill: Understanding user friction and cognitive load turns directly into hypothesis testing.
Knowing user complaints identifies high-leverage product bugs and feature requests.

essential_skills: A/B Testing & Hypothesis Testing (p-values, statistical power)
Funnel & Retention Cohort Analysis in SQL
Product Metrics (DAU/MAU, North Star, Churn, Stickiness)
Exploratory Data Analysis in Python / SQL

portfolio_projects.title: Mobile App Onboarding Funnel & Drop-Off Investigation
portfolio_projects.scenario: Analyzed 45,000 mobile onboarding events in SQL to isolate a 38% drop-off at phone OTP verification, proposing a social-login solution that boosted conversion.

career_paths.entry_requirements: Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Deep intuition for user psychology and fluency in experiment design metrics are prioritized over purely theoretical math.
career_paths.common_barriers: P-hacking and ending A/B tests prematurely; failing to differentiate between vanity metrics (page views) and actionable retention metrics.

phases.focus: Data Foundations, Product Metrics (LTV, CAC, Retention, DAU/MAU)
SQL: Advanced joins, Window functions for user sessionization
A/B Testing Statistics: Sample sizing, Normal distributions, P-values, Z-tests
Event tracking tools (Mixpanel/Amplitude concepts) & Python EDA
Complete Product Case Study, Resume Engineering & PM Mock Interviews

career_paths.title: Marketing & Growth Analyst
career_paths.summary: Evaluates multi-channel ad spend, computes Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), builds multi-touch attribution models, and optimizes customer journey lifecycles.
career_paths.summary_hi: मार्केटिंग कैंपेन्स और विज्ञापनों का ROI निकालना। कौन सा विज्ञापन ज्यादा ग्राहक ला रहा है, प्रति ग्राहक लागत (CAC) क्या है, और बजट कहाँ खर्च होना चाहिए।
day_to_day: Aggregate performance data across Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn, and email marketing channels.
Calculate key unit economics: CAC, Payback Period, ROAS, and Lifetime Value (LTV).
Build and evaluate attribution models (First-Touch, Last-Touch, Linear, Data-Driven).
Analyze email marketing metrics (Open rates, Click-through rates, Churn, Unsubscribe rates).
Provide weekly budget reallocation recommendations to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO).
career_paths.background_applicability: Exceptionally friendly to non-technical professionals. Digital marketers, copywriters, content creators, PR managers, and media buyers excel by adding SQL and visualization skills.

transferable_skills.skill: Familiarity with ad campaign metrics (CPC, CTR, impressions) accelerates analysis.
Understanding audience messaging helps formulate targeted customer segmentation.

essential_skills: Marketing Unit Economics (CAC, LTV, ROAS, Payback Period)

portfolio_projects.title: Omni-Channel Marketing Budget Allocation & ROAS Optimizer
portfolio_projects.scenario: Analyzed $450,000 in quarterly ad spend across 4 channels to eliminate $65,000 in non-converting keywords and improve blended ROAS from 2.4x to 3.8x.

career_paths.entry_requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or any related field. Portfolio showing ability to turn marketing campaign data into cost savings and revenue gains.
career_paths.common_barriers: Relying strictly on platform-reported numbers (Meta over-reporting conversions); lack of SQL skills to query raw data warehouse tables beyond native ad dashboards.

phases.focus: Marketing metrics & unit economics (CAC, LTV, ROAS, Attribution models)

career_paths.title: Financial & FP&A Data Analyst
career_paths.summary: Modernizes financial planning, variance analysis, annual budgeting, and cash flow forecasting by integrating relational SQL databases and Power BI with traditional 3-statement models.
career_paths.summary_hi: कंपनी के वित्तीय स्वास्थ्य, बजट, प्रॉफिट-लॉस और खर्चों का विश्लेषण। SQL और Power BI के जरिए पुराने एक्सेल मॉडल्स को ऑटोमेट करना।
day_to_day: Prepare monthly Financial Variance Analyses comparing Actuals vs Budget/Forecast.
Build dynamic 3-statement financial models (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow).
Query ERP and General Ledger databases (SAP, NetSuite, Oracle) using SQL.
Model capital expenditure (CapEx), operating expenses (OpEx), and headcount costs.
Present rolling quarterly earnings forecasts to Finance Directors and the CFO.
career_paths.background_applicability: Highly suitable for candidates from commerce, accounting, economics, banking, and audit backgrounds seeking to modernize their analytical toolkit beyond static spreadsheets.

transferable_skills.skill: Knowledge of debits/credits, GAAP principles, and trial balance reconciliation.
Interest rate mechanics, liquidity ratios, and risk assessment.

essential_skills: Financial Statement Analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
Advanced Financial Modeling in Excel (DCF, Scenario analysis)

portfolio_projects.scenario: Automated a manual 3-day close process into a 15-minute refresh in Power BI, detecting a recurring $85,000 vendor overcharge variance.

career_paths.title: Operations & Supply Chain Analyst
career_paths.summary: Monitors supply chain throughput, warehouse fulfillment cycle times, supplier delivery reliability, inventory stock-outs, and courier service level agreements (SLAs).
career_paths.summary_hi: सप्लाई चेन, वेयरहाउसिंग, डिलीवरी स्पीड और लॉजिस्टिक्स ऑपरेशन्स को बेहतर बनाना। इन्वेंटरी की बर्बादी रोकना और सामान समय पर पहुंचाना।
day_to_day: Track order-to-dispatch and fulfillment cycle times across regional distribution hubs.
Calculate safety stock, economic order quantity (EOQ), and reorder points.
Evaluate courier shipping partner on-time performance and SLA breach penalties.
Investigate supply chain bottlenecks and process delays using SQL and BPMN mapping.
Publish daily operations briefings for warehouse managers and logistics directors.
career_paths.background_applicability: Highly accessible to non-technical individuals. Professionals from logistics, warehouse management, hotel management, retail, and manufacturing make strong transitions.

transferable_skills.skill: Firsthand familiarity with dispatch processes and inventory counts.
Managing escalations, expediting critical requests, and SLA tracking.

essential_skills: Supply Chain Metrics (OTIF, Lead Time, EOQ, Stockout Rate)

portfolio_projects.title: Warehouse Fulfillment Bottleneck & On-Time Delivery (OTIF) Tracker
portfolio_projects.scenario: Analyzed 80,000 logistics shipments to identify a packaging bottleneck causing a 3.2-day delay in western regional hubs, improving OTIF from 81% to 94%.

career_paths.entry_requirements: Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Practical knowledge of logistics workflows, inventory fundamentals, and SQL.
career_paths.common_barriers: Failing to connect analytical insights with physical warehouse realities; inability to translate operational data into monetary savings.

day_to_day: Analyze international ocean and air freight container utilization and transit bottlenecks.
Monitor vendor compliance, price variance against raw material indexes, and delivery lead times.
Forecast demand surges to prevent stock-outs during peak holiday shopping periods.
Audit freight invoices and customs duties to prevent overpayment discrepancies.
Build executive supplier scorecards tracking ESG metrics and delivery SLAs.
career_paths.background_applicability: Highly accessible to non-technical professionals. Backgrounds in foreign trade, maritime logistics, warehouse dispatch, procurement, and hotel purchase management transfer seamlessly.

Bill of Lading documentation, customs tariffs, and multi-modal transit.

career_paths.common_barriers: Failing to consider real-world shipping tariffs, fuel surcharges, and customs clearance delays in mathematical models.

courses.title: Computer & Programming Foundations: Environment Setup for Windows & macOS
courses.title_hi: कंप्यूटर और प्रोग्रामिंग बेसिक्स: विंडोज और मैक सेटअप (Computer Foundations)
courses.prerequisites: None. Open to anyone with a Windows 10/11 or macOS computer.
courses.description: Prepare your computer for professional data analysis: terminal/PowerShell mastery, installing Python 3.12+, configuring Visual Studio Code, virtual environments (venv), pip package management, PATH troubleshooting, and database clients.
courses.description_hi: अपने लैपटॉप को डेटा एनालिसिस के लिए तैयार करें: Windows PowerShell और macOS Terminal, Python 3.12+ सही तरीके से इंस्टॉल करना, VS Code सेटअप, वर्चुअल एनवायरनमेंट (venv), pip और PATH एरर्स को ठीक करना।
learning_objectives: Navigate file systems, folders, file extensions, and permissions using Windows PowerShell and macOS zsh.
Install and update Python on Windows and macOS using official current releases, ensuring PATH registration.
Install, configure, and customize Visual Studio Code with the official Python extension.
Create, activate, and manage isolated virtual environments (venv) and install packages with pip.
Troubleshoot common setup pitfalls: 'command not found', execution policy restrictions, interpreter mismatch, and PATH errors.
Install cross-platform database clients (DBeaver, SQLite CLI) and connect to local data sources.
courses.final_project_teaser: Initialize a reproducible Data Analyst workspace: virtual environment, requirements.txt, sample script, and DBeaver SQLite connection.

courses.title: Data Analysis Foundations & The Analyst Role
courses.title_hi: डेटा एनालिसिस बेसिक्स और एनालिस्ट का रोल (Data Foundations)
courses.prerequisites: None. Open for absolute beginners and non-technical career switchers.
courses.description: Understand the end-to-end data lifecycle, analyst vs scientist vs engineer distinctions, metrics vs dimensions, and the SMART problem-framing framework.
courses.description_hi: डेटा एनालिस्ट का काम क्या होता है, डेटा लाइफसाइकिल कैसे काम करता है, बिजनेस प्रॉब्लम को डेटा मैट्रिक्स में कैसे बदलें, और इस फील्ड में करियर कैसे बनाएं।
learning_objectives: Understand the end-to-end data lifecycle: Ingestion, Cleaning, EDA, Modeling, Presentation.
Differentiate between Data Analyst, Data Scientist, and Data Engineer roles and toolsets.
Frame business problems using the SMART and Issue-Tree frameworks.
Distinguish between quantitative vs qualitative data, and metrics vs dimensions.
Learn how modern companies make revenue and cut costs through data-driven decisions.
courses.final_project_teaser: Create a 1-page Business Problem Framing Document (BRD) analyzing why an online grocery platform experienced a 20% drop in cart conversions.

courses.title: Basic Statistics & Probability for Analysts
courses.description: Master descriptive and inferential statistics: mean vs median, variance, normal distribution, standard deviation, p-values, hypothesis testing, and correlation vs causation.
courses.description_hi: डेटा का सही मतलब समझें: Mean, Median, Mode, Standard Deviation, Normal Distribution, A/B Testing, p-value और Correlation vs Causation आसान भाषा में।
learning_objectives: Calculate and interpret measures of central tendency (Mean, Median, Mode) and dispersion (Variance, Std Dev, IQR).
Understand distributions: Normal distribution, 68-95-99.7 empirical rule, Skewness, and Kurtosis.
Grasp Probability basics, conditional probability, and expected value.
Execute Hypothesis Testing: Null vs Alternative hypotheses, Type I / Type II errors, and p-value significance.
Identify sampling biases and distinguish correlation from causation in real business metrics.
courses.final_project_teaser: Perform an A/B Test Statistical Significance Report comparing two checkout page designs for an e-commerce platform.

courses.title: Excel: Zero to Advanced for Data Analysts
courses.title_hi: एक्सेल: जीरो से एडवांस्ड (Excel Zero to Advanced)
courses.description: From basic navigation to XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, nested logic, Power Query ETL, and executive KPI modeling.
courses.description_hi: एक्सेल में एक्सपर्ट बनें: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, Conditional Formatting, Power Query और डायनामिक डैशबोर्ड बनाना सीखें।
learning_objectives: Navigate Excel fluently with keyboard shortcuts and clean spreadsheet design principles.
Master modern lookup functions: XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, nested IFs, and switch logic.
Aggregate multidimensional business data using SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, and AVERAGEIFS.
Build dynamic, sliced Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts with custom calculated fields.
Use Power Query to import, transform, unpivot, and merge multi-file datasets automatically.
courses.final_project_teaser: Build an Automated Monthly Sales & Margin KPI Workbook with dynamic slicers and executive summary.

courses.title: SQL: Zero to Advanced for Relational Databases
courses.title_hi: एसक्यूएल: जीरो से एडवांस्ड (SQL Zero to Advanced)
courses.prerequisites: None. Direct hands-on querying from lesson one.
courses.description: Write production-grade SQL queries: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, multi-table JOINs, subqueries, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), and Window Functions.
courses.description_hi: डेटाबेस से डेटा निकालना सीखें: SELECT, WHERE, JOINs (Inner, Left, Full), Group By, Having, Subqueries, CTEs (WITH) और Window Functions (RANK, ROW_NUMBER, LAG, LEAD)।
learning_objectives: Understand relational schema design, primary keys, foreign keys, and normalization.
Filter, sort, and aggregate transactional data using WHERE, GROUP BY, and HAVING.
Join multiple tables using INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL OUTER joins.
Structure modular, readable queries using CTEs (Common Table Expressions) and subqueries.
Harness Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG) for cohort and running total analysis.
courses.final_project_teaser: Perform an End-to-End Customer Retention and Order Funnel SQL Audit on a multi-table database.

courses.title: Python for Data Analysis: Pandas, NumPy & Wrangling
courses.title_hi: पायथन फॉर डेटा एनालिसिस (Python for Data Analysis)
courses.description: Learn Python fundamentals, Pandas DataFrames, NumPy vectorization, data cleaning, filtering, grouping, merging, and exploratory data analysis (EDA).
courses.description_hi: पायथन और पांडास सीखें: DataFrames, Data Manipulation, Missing Values Handle करना, Groupby Aggregations, और डेटा से पैटर्न्स खोजना।
learning_objectives: Master Python data structures: lists, dicts, tuples, sets, and list comprehensions.
Load, inspect, slice, and filter datasets using Pandas DataFrames and Series.
Handle missing values (NaNs), duplicates, and incorrect data types systematically.
Perform high-performance grouped aggregations and multi-key joins in Pandas.
Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to uncover trends, outliers, and distributions.
courses.final_project_teaser: Conduct a complete Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on an e-commerce transactions dataset with automated summary reports.

courses.title: Data Cleaning, Preparation & Quality Assurance
courses.title_hi: डेटा क्लीनिंग और प्रेपरेशन (Data Cleaning & Quality)
courses.prerequisites: Excel basics or SQL / Python familiarity.
courses.description: Industry data is 80% dirty. Learn outlier detection with IQR, string parsing with regex, missing value imputation, type casting, and schema validation.
courses.description_hi: कच्चे और गंदे डेटा को क्लीन करना सीखें: Outliers पहचानना, Regex से टेक्स्ट क्लीनिंग, Missing Values भरना और Data Integrity Checks लगाना।
learning_objectives: Detect and treat missing data via domain-appropriate imputation (mean, median, forward fill, or deletion).
Identify univariate and multivariate outliers using IQR (Interquartile Range) and Z-score methods.
Standardize messy text, date formats, phone numbers, and inconsistent categorical entries.
Detect and deduplicate exact and fuzzy record matches across datasets.
Establish automated Data Quality Assurance (QA) rule checklists before analysis.
courses.final_project_teaser: Clean a corrupted real-world customer CRM and transaction dataset and generate an Audit Quality Certificate.

courses.title: Data Visualization & Storytelling for Stakeholders
courses.title_hi: डेटा विज़ुअलाइज़ेशन और स्टोरीटेलिंग (Data Visualization & Storytelling)
courses.description: Choose the right chart for the right question, apply pre-attentive attributes, declutter visuals, and present data stories that drive executive decisions.
courses.description_hi: डेटा से सही कहानी कहना सीखें: कौन सा चार्ट कब यूज़ करें, कलर्स और लेआउट के नियम, और बॉसेज/क्लाइंट्स को इम्प्रेस करने वाली प्रेजेंटेशन्स।
learning_objectives: Select optimal chart types (Bar, Line, Scatter, Heatmap, Waterfall) according to data relationships.
Apply cognitive load reduction: eliminate chartjunk, optimize gridlines, and maximize data-to-ink ratio.
Leverage pre-attentive attributes (color, size, position) to direct stakeholder attention to key insights.
Structure analytical presentations using the Situation-Complication-Resolution (SCR) framework.
Write executive summaries that link metrics to concrete business dollar impacts.
courses.final_project_teaser: Redesign a cluttered, confusing 10-chart corporate deck into a 2-page compelling executive decision story.

courses.title: Power BI & Tableau: Dashboards & Business Intelligence
courses.title_hi: पावर बीआई और टैब्लू (Power BI & Tableau Mastery)
courses.prerequisites: Excel formulas and basic data modeling concepts.
courses.description: Star Schema data modeling, DAX measures (CALCULATE, RELATED, SUMX), Tableau calculated fields, Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, parameters, and live executive reports.
courses.description_hi: Power BI और Tableau सीखें: Star Schema रिलेशनशिप्स, DAX फॉर्मूले (CALCULATE, SUMX), Tableau LODs, और लाइव इंटरएक्टिव रिपोर्ट्स बनाना।
learning_objectives: Extract, transform, and clean disparate tables using Power Query M transformations.
Build dimensional models: Fact tables, Dimension tables, Star Schema, and active/inactive relationships.
Master essential DAX measures: implicit vs explicit measures, CALCULATE, FILTER, RELATED, and Time Intelligence.
Master Tableau Dimensions vs Measures, Marks cards, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE).
Publish, configure row-level security (RLS), and schedule auto-refresh on cloud reporting workspaces.
courses.final_project_teaser: Design a complete Retail Executive Performance Dashboard in Power BI with YoY growth, margin waterfalls, and drill-through pages.

courses.title: Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering
courses.title_hi: बिजनेस एनालिसिस और रिक्वायरमेंट्स गैदरिंग (Business Analysis)
courses.description: Bridge the gap between business leaders and data engineers: authoring BRDs, scoping PRDs, elicitation interviews, KPI tree structuring, and scope creep management.
courses.description_hi: बिजनेस और टेक टीमों के बीच पुल बनें: रिक्वायरमेंट्स डॉक्यूमेंट (BRD) लिखना, स्टेकहोल्डर्स से सही सवाल पूछना, और KPI ट्री बनाना।
learning_objectives: Conduct stakeholder elicitation interviews without using intimidating technical jargon.
Author Business Requirements Documents (BRD) and Data Dictionary specifications.
Prevent scope creep through change-request workflows and priority matrices (MoSCoW).
Translate ambiguous business questions into measurable analytical metrics and SLAs.
Structure KPI trees linking leading operational indicators to lagging financial outcomes.
courses.final_project_teaser: Author a comprehensive BRD & Metric Specification Document for a Chief Marketing Officer's new attribution dashboard.

courses.title: Jira, Azure Basics & BPMN Process Mapping
courses.title_hi: जीरा, एज्योर और प्रोसेस मैपिंग (Jira, Azure & BPMN)
courses.description: Agile and Scrum workflows for data teams: user stories with Gherkin acceptance criteria, sprint planning, Jira & Azure DevOps boards, plus BPMN 2.0 swimlane workflow mapping.
courses.description_hi: कंपनियों में काम करने का तरीका: Agile/Scrum क्या है, Jira टिकट्स कैसे बनते हैं, यूजर स्टोरीज कैसे लिखें, और BPMN प्रोसेस फ्लोचार्ट्स कैसे बनाएं।
learning_objectives: Understand Agile principles, Scrum roles (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Analyst), and daily standup rituals.
Write data user stories with Acceptance Criteria (Given-When-Then format).
Manage sprint backlogs, Kanban boards, and estimate tasks using story points.
Master standard BPMN 2.0 notation: Events, Activities, Gateways, Pools, and Swimlanes.
Chart current-state ('As-Is') workflows to pinpoint operational bottlenecks, and design optimized 'To-Be' solutions.
courses.final_project_teaser: Map an 'As-Is' Loan Approval Process of a bank, identify the 3-day bottleneck, and design the optimized 'To-Be' workflow.

courses.title: Technical Communication & Presenting Findings
courses.description: How to explain complex analytical models to non-technical leaders, structure 1-page executive memos (Minto Pyramid), handle tough questions, and speak with confidence.
courses.description_hi: बॉस और नॉन-टेक लोगों को डेटा समझाना: 1-पेज एग्जीक्यूटिव मेमो लिखना, Minto Pyramid स्ट्रक्चर, और मीटिंग्स में कॉन्फिडेंस से बोलना।
learning_objectives: Apply the Minto Pyramid Principle: Lead with the answer, group supporting insights, summarize with action items.
Draft concise 1-page analytical executive memos for CEO / VP level.
Translate statistical terms (p-value, standard deviation, R-squared) into business dollars and risks.
Handle challenging executive objections and data ambiguity without defensive posturing.
Design accessible visual presentation slides with high data-to-ink ratio.
courses.final_project_teaser: Draft a 1-page Executive Decision Memo advising leadership on whether to expand into a new regional market based on cohort analysis.

courses.title: Soft Skills for Analysts: Critical Thinking & Teamwork
courses.title_hi: सॉफ्ट स्किल्स: क्रिटिकल थिंकिंग और टीमवर्क (Analyst Soft Skills)
courses.description: Cognitive biases in analysis (confirmation bias, survivorship bias), active listening, effective feedback, time management for ad-hoc requests, and cross-functional empathy.
courses.description_hi: सफल एनालिस्ट के मानवीय गुण: डेटा बायस से बचना, एक्टिव लिसनिंग, समय प्रबंधन, और डेवलपर्स व बिजनेस लीडर्स के साथ बेहतरीन तालमेल।
learning_objectives: Identify and counteract cognitive biases: confirmation bias, survivorship bias, and availability heuristic.
Practice active listening to uncover the unstated business problem behind an ad-hoc data pull request.
Triage urgent vs important data requests using the Eisenhower Matrix to protect deep-work focus time.
Deliver constructive feedback and partner effectively across engineering, product, and sales teams.
Develop analytical curiosity and resilience when data does not validate initial organizational hypotheses.
courses.final_project_teaser: Conduct a Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys Framework) on a failed operational product rollout.

courses.title: Planning, Building & Presenting Portfolio Projects
courses.title_hi: पोर्टफोलियो प्रोजेक्ट्स: प्लानिंग और प्रेजेंटेशन (Portfolio Blueprint)
courses.description: Step-by-step framework to pick high-signal datasets, avoid generic Titanic/Iris projects, structure problem statements, write compelling GitHub READMEs, and publish interactive web dashboards.
courses.description_hi: ऐसा पोर्टफोलियो बनाएं जिसे देखकर रिक्रूटर तुरंत कॉल करे: अनोखे डेटासेट्स चुनना, टाइटैनिक/आइरिस जैसे घिसे-पिटे प्रोजेक्ट्स से बचना, और इम्प्रेसिव README लिखना।
learning_objectives: Select unique, domain-relevant public datasets (e.g. logistics, healthcare, fin-tech) that prove business value.
Structure portfolio projects using the 5-part architecture: Problem, Approach, Analysis, Insights, Business Impact.
Author professional GitHub repository README files with architecture diagrams and reproducible instructions.
Host and publish interactive web dashboards using Streamlit, Power BI Public, or Tableau Public.
Record 2-minute video walkthrough demos showcasing communication and executive presence.
courses.final_project_teaser: Complete the master documentation and architecture diagram for your primary capstone project ready for public hosting.

courses.title: GitHub & Version Control Basics for Data Analysts
courses.title_hi: गिट और गिटहब बेसिक्स (Git & GitHub for Analysts)
courses.prerequisites: Basic command line or terminal awareness.
courses.description: Git commands: init, add, commit, push, pull, branches, merge conflicts, pull requests, .gitignore, and hosting professional data portfolio repositories on GitHub.
courses.description_hi: कोड को सुरक्षित रखना और दुनिया को दिखाना: Git कमांड्स (commit, push, pull), ब्रांचेज, .gitignore, और GitHub प्रोफाइल को सजाना।
learning_objectives: Understand the difference between Git (local version control system) and GitHub (cloud collaboration platform).
Execute the core Git workflow: git clone, git status, git add, git commit, and git push.
Configure .gitignore files to protect API keys, database credentials, and huge CSV raw files from leaking.
Create and merge feature branches, open Pull Requests, and resolve merge conflicts cleanly.
Build a modern GitHub Profile README highlighting projects, technical stack badges, and analytical case studies.
courses.final_project_teaser: Initialize a local Git repository, configure a robust .gitignore for data files, and push a polished portfolio repository to GitHub.

courses.title: Responsible Use of AI Tools, Prompting & Verification
courses.title_hi: AI टूल्स का सही उपयोग और प्रॉम्प्टिंग (Responsible AI & Prompting)
courses.description: Leverage AI (LLMs) effectively as a data analyst copilot: advanced prompt engineering, verifying SQL/Python output, preventing hallucinations, data privacy, and ethical AI safeguards.
courses.description_hi: AI को अपना स्मार्ट असिस्टेंट बनाएं: सही प्रॉम्प्ट्स लिखना, AI के कोड में गलतियां पकड़ना, डेटा प्राइवेसी का ध्यान रखना, और हॉलुसिनेशन से बचना।
learning_objectives: Craft high-performance prompts using Role-Task-Context-Format (RTCF) and Few-Shot prompting techniques.
Use LLMs safely to accelerate SQL query drafting, regex construction, and Python error diagnosis.
Rigorously audit and verify AI-generated analytical calculations against ground truth datasets to catch silent hallucinations.
Enforce data privacy protocols: Never paste sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) or proprietary corporate financials into public LLMs.
Understand ethical AI considerations: algorithmic bias, fair lending/hiring metrics, and transparency.

interview_questions.question_en: What causes a SQL query to accidentally duplicate rows during a JOIN, and how do you detect and fix it?
interview_questions.question_hi: SQL JOIN के दौरान पंक्तियों का अनपेक्षित डुप्लीकेशन (Fanout) क्यों होता है, और इसे कैसे ठीक किया जाता है?
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
**1. The Root Cause (Cartesian Fanout):**
Accidental row duplication happens when joining two tables on a key that is not unique in both tables (a Many-to-Many relationship). For example, joining a `Customers` table to both `Orders` (1 customer has 5 orders) and `SupportTickets` (1 customer has 3 tickets) produces 15 rows for that single customer instead of 5 or 3!

**2. How to Detect Duplication:**
- Compare row counts before and after the JOIN:
  ```sql
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), COUNT(*) FROM FinalDataset;
  ```
  If `COUNT(*)` is significantly larger than `COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)` where a 1:1 relationship was expected, fanout occurred.

**3. How to Fix It:**
- **Pre-Aggregate in a CTE:** Never join two independent 1:Many child tables directly. Aggregate each table to the customer level first:
  ```sql
  WITH CustomerOrders AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_spend, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id
  ),
  CustomerTickets AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
    FROM support_tickets GROUP BY customer_id
  )
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, co.total_spend, ct.ticket_count
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN CustomerOrders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN CustomerTickets ct ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id;
  ```
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
अनपेक्षित डुप्लीकेशन (Fanout) तब होता है जब आप दो ऐसी टेबल्स को जोड़ते हैं जिनमें जॉइन की (Key) यूनिक नहीं होती। 
समाधान: जॉइन करने से पहले दोनों टेबल्स को CTE या सबक्वेरी में GROUP BY करके एग्रीगेट करें, फिर मेन टेबल से जोड़ें।
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["1. Explain many-to-many (M:M) relationships and non-unique join keys.","2. Illustrate with a concrete example (Customer joined to Orders and Subscriptions).","3. Describe detection techniques (comparing row counts before and after join).","4. Explain remediation strategies (pre-aggregating before join, using CTEs, or joining on composite primary keys)."]
interview_questions.common_pitfalls: ["Suggesting 'Just slap a SELECT DISTINCT at the top' (DISTINCT masks the underlying architectural bug and wastes massive server CPU/RAM).","Not understanding the difference between 1:Many and Many:Many joins."]
interview_questions.detailed_explanation: Senior analysts check for this immediately because Cartesian explosions cause inaccurate financial metrics and slow database performance.

interview_questions.question_en: Why is XLOOKUP considered superior to VLOOKUP in modern Excel? Describe at least three specific technical advantages.
interview_questions.question_hi: आधुनिक एक्सेल में VLOOKUP की तुलना में XLOOKUP को बेहतर क्यों माना जाता है? कम से कम 3 तकनीकी कारण बताइए।
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
`XLOOKUP` replaces both `VLOOKUP` and `HLOOKUP` with four major technical advantages:

1. **Immunity to Structural Changes (Inserted Columns):**
   - `VLOOKUP(lookup_value, table_array, col_index_num, FALSE)` relies on a hardcoded static column index (e.g. `3`). If someone inserts a new column in column B, VLOOKUP returns the wrong data silently!
   - `XLOOKUP(lookup_value, lookup_array, return_array)` uses direct cell references, automatically adjusting if columns are moved, inserted, or deleted.

2. **Lookups to the Left:**
   - `VLOOKUP` can only search the leftmost column and return data to its right.
   - `XLOOKUP` can search anywhere and return data to the left or right seamlessly.

3. **Default Exact Match:**
   - `VLOOKUP` defaults to approximate match (`TRUE`), which causes subtle, dangerous errors if the 4th argument is omitted. `XLOOKUP` defaults safely to exact match.

4. **Built-in Error Handling:**
   - `XLOOKUP` includes an optional `[if_not_found]` argument, eliminating the need to wrap formulas in bloated `=IFERROR(..., "Not Found")`.
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
XLOOKUP के 3 मुख्य फायदे:
1. नया कॉलम जोड़ने पर फॉर्मूला नहीं टूटता।
2. बाईं तरफ (Left Lookup) भी डेटा खोज सकता है।
3. डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से सटीक मिलान (Exact Match) करता है और इसमें एरर हैंडलिंग पहले से मौजूद है।
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["1. Default exact match behavior.","2. Left-lookup capability (no column order restriction).","3. Immunity to column insertion/deletion.","4. Built-in IFERROR handling via [if_not_found] argument."]
interview_questions.common_pitfalls: ["Forgetting that older Excel versions (prior to Excel 2021/Microsoft 365) do not support XLOOKUP, where INDEX/MATCH remains the required enterprise standard.","Not knowing the arguments of XLOOKUP."]
interview_questions.detailed_explanation: Excel modeling requires defensive architecture. Using robust references prevents spreadsheet errors in recurring corporate reporting.

interview_questions.question_en: How do you detect, evaluate, and handle missing values in a Pandas DataFrame? When is imputation dangerous?
interview_questions.question_hi: Pandas DataFrame में मिसिंग वैल्यूज की पहचान और हैंडलिंग कैसे करते हैं? इम्पुटेशन (Imputation) कब खतरनाक हो सकता है?
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
**1. Detection & Profiling:**
First, quantify missingness as counts and percentages:
```python
missing_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'missing_count': df.isna().sum(),
    'missing_pct': (df.isna().mean() * 100).round(2)
}).sort_values(by='missing_pct', ascending=False)
```

**2. Strategy by Data Type & Business Context:**
- **High missingness (>60%):** Drop the column unless domain experts confirm the absence itself is informative (e.g. `churn_reason` is only filled by churned users!).
- **Categorical Variables:** Impute with `"Unknown"` or create an explicit missing indicator flag rather than guessing the mode.
- **Numerical Variables:** Impute using **Median** (robust to outliers) rather than Mean if skewed.
- **Time Series:** Use forward-fill (`ffill`) with a limit to avoid stale carry-over.

**3. When Imputation is Dangerous:**
- **Distorting Variance:** Imputing a constant mean artificially reduces variance, shrinking standard deviation and inflating false statistical confidence.
- **Data Leakage:** Computing the mean across the entire dataset before train/test splitting leaks future information into evaluation sets.
- **MNAR (Missing Not At Random):** In customer satisfaction surveys, unhappy customers often refuse to answer income questions. Imputing the median distorts the customer demographic reality.
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
मिसिंग वैल्यूज को df.isna().sum() से पहचानते हैं। 
सावधानी: बिना सोचे-समझे Mean भरने से डेटा का फैलाव (Variance) घट जाता है। अगर डेटा में आउटलायर्स हैं तो हमेशा Median का उपयोग करें या "Unknown" श्रेणी बनाएं।
interview_questions.skill_assessed: Handling Missing Data & Preventing Data Leakage
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["1. Detection methods (.isna().sum(), percentage of missingness).","2. Categorizing the missingness mechanism (MCAR, MAR, MNAR).","3. Treatment options (dropping vs mean/median vs forward-fill vs domain default).","4. The danger of data leakage and distorting variance."]
interview_questions.common_pitfalls: ["Saying 'Just drop all rows with missing values' (this can wipe out 40% of the sample size and introduce survivor bias).","Blindly using Mean imputation on skewed financial data (e.g. salary, account balances)."]
interview_questions.detailed_explanation: Data analysts must balance statistical rigor with business truth. Demonstrating awareness of bias proves hands-on experience.

interview_questions.question_en: How would you explain a p-value of 0.03 to a non-technical Marketing Director after an A/B test?
interview_questions.question_hi: A/B टेस्टिंग के बाद किसी नॉन-टेक्निकल मार्केटिंग डायरेक्टर को p-value = 0.03 को सरल भाषा में कैसे समझाएंगे?
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
**How I would explain it directly in a stakeholder meeting:**

"Marketing team, think of our A/B test like flipping a coin. 

If our new green checkout button actually had zero real advantage over the old blue button, there is only a **3% chance** that we would see this revenue increase purely by random coincidence.

Because 3% is lower than our standard company risk threshold of 5% (the p < 0.05 rule), we are **97% confident** that the revenue lift was driven by the new design, not random luck. 

**My recommendation:** The evidence is statistically solid. We should proceed with rolling out the new checkout button to 100% of users."
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
**सरल शब्दों में समझाने का तरीका:**
"सर, मान लीजिए नए हरे बटन में कोई जादू नहीं है। फिर भी केवल किस्मत या संयोग से इतना फायदा दिखने की संभावना सिर्फ 3% है। 
यानी हम 97% आश्वस्त हैं कि यह बिक्री नए बटन की वजह से ही बढ़ी है। इसलिए हमें इसे सभी ग्राहकों के लिए लॉन्च कर देना चाहिए।"
interview_questions.skill_assessed: Explaining p-values & Statistical Significance in Plain Language
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["1. Avoid technical academic jargon (do not say 'probability of observing extreme test statistics under the null hypothesis').","2. Use an intuitive analogy (e.g. coin flip or random luck).","3. State the business confidence level (97% confidence).","4. Connect directly to action: can we launch the campaign?"]
interview_questions.common_pitfalls: ["Saying 'The p-value is the probability that the null hypothesis is true' (statistically incorrect).","Saying 'There is a 97% chance the new button is better by exactly $10' (p-value tests existence of an effect, not effect size).","Using complex formulas that alienate business partners."]
interview_questions.detailed_explanation: A data analyst's value comes from translating statistical rigors into confident business decisions. Plain language communication is actively evaluated.

interview_questions.question_en: Our e-commerce website experienced an 18% drop in checkout conversion rate last week, while traffic remained flat. Walk me through your step-by-step diagnostic framework.
interview_questions.question_hi: हमारी ई-कॉमर्स वेबसाइट का चेकआउट कन्वर्ज़न पिछले हफ्ते 18% गिर गया, जबकि ट्रैफ़िक उतना ही था। आपकी जांच की स्टेप-बाय-स्टेप रूपरेखा क्या होगी?
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
I would follow a structured 4-phase diagnostic investigation:

**Phase 1: Validate Data Integrity (Never assume the data is correct):**
- Verify if the tracking pixel or analytics logging broke. Did the definition of "Conversion" change?
- Check if total order volume dropped, or if only the recorded metric dropped.

**Phase 2: Dimensional Segmentation (Isolate where the bleeding is happening):**
- **By Device & Browser:** Did iOS drop while Android remained stable? (Points to an iOS app release bug or Safari WebKit update).
- **By Geography:** Is the drop localized to a specific region? (Points to local internet outage, weather, or distribution issue).
- **By Payment Method:** Did UPI or Credit Card failure rates spike? (Points to a payment gateway API outage).
- **By User Type:** New vs Returning visitors.

**Phase 3: Checkout Funnel Drop-off Analysis:**
Inspect the 4-step checkout funnel:
Cart View -> Shipping Details -> Payment Selection -> OTP Confirmation.
If drop-off spiked specifically at Step 3 (Payment), the problem is payment processing rather than product interest.

**Phase 4: Internal Releases vs External Shocks:**
- Check git deployment logs: Was new code shipped to production last Thursday?
- Review pricing & marketing: Did shipping fees increase, or did promotional discount codes expire?

**Synthesis:** Synthesize findings into an immediate stakeholder Slack update with root-cause confirmation and an engineering ticket.
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
**4-चरणों वाली जांच पद्धति:**
1. **डेटा इंटीग्रिटी:** क्या एनालिटिक्स ट्रैकिंग कोड टूटा है या सच में ऑर्डर घटे हैं?
2. **सेगमेंटेशन:** डिवाइस (iOS/Android), पेमेंट गेटवे, और शहर के आधार पर डेटा को काटें।
3. **फनल एनालिसिस:** ग्राहक किस स्टेप (कार्ट, पता या पेमेंट) पर सबसे ज्यादा ड्रॉप हो रहे हैं?
4. **इंजीनियरिंग रिलीज:** क्या पिछले हफ्ते कोई नया कोड या ऐप अपडेट लॉन्च हुआ था?
interview_questions.skill_assessed: Root Cause Analysis Framework for Metric Drops
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["1. Clarify & Validate: Verify data integrity first (did a tracking script break?).","2. Segment the drop: Cut across dimensions (Device/OS, Geography, Payment Gateway, Product Category, User Type).","3. Funnel Analysis: Where in the multi-step checkout funnel did users drop off?","4. External vs Internal Factors: Look at releases, outages, pricing changes, or competitor campaigns.","5. Synthesis & Action: Recommend fix and communicate to engineering/executive teams."]
interview_questions.common_pitfalls: ["Jumping immediately to conclusions ('Let's lower prices!') without investigating the technical funnel.","Forgetting to verify payment gateway partner health.","Failing to articulate a calm, structured mental model."]
interview_questions.detailed_explanation: Case study questions evaluate structured thinking under uncertainty. Employers want to see systematic elimination of hypotheses.

interview_questions.question_en: Walk me through the most technically complex data project in your portfolio. What analytical trade-offs did you make, and what were the limitations of your dataset?
interview_questions.question_hi: अपने पोर्टफोलियो के सबसे बेहतरीन प्रोजेक्ट के बारे में बताइए। आपने क्या तकनीकी समझौते किए और आपके डेटासेट की क्या सीमाएं थीं?
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
**1. Project Objective:**
"In my E-Commerce Sales & Margin Diagnostic Project, I analyzed 500,000 transaction records for an omnichannel electronics retailer experiencing revenue growth but an 8% drop in profit margin.

**2. Architecture & Pipeline:**
I built a clean relational model in SQLite, transformed features in Python with Pandas, and modeled dimensional relationships in Power BI.

**3. The Critical Analytical Trade-off:**
During data cleaning, I discovered that 12% of customer transaction records lacked delivery partner timestamp logs. I faced a trade-off: either drop those records and lose 12% of revenue visibility, or impute delivery lead times using regional median transit times. I chose to create a segmented sub-analysis: I analyzed profitability on the 100% complete dataset, and evaluated delivery SLA bottlenecks strictly on the subset of verified logistic logs.

**4. Dataset Limitations:**
The dataset lacked direct customer return reason codes. We could see *which* products were returned, but not *why* (defect vs wrong size). I explicitly documented this limitation in my README.

**5. Business Impact:**
My analysis uncovered that discounted shipping promotions on sub-$20 items were eroding category margins by 22%. I recommended instituting a $35 minimum threshold for free shipping, projected to restore $140,000 in net quarterly margin."
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
अपने प्रोजेक्ट को समझाते समय:
1. बिजनेस की समस्या क्या थी?
2. आपने कौन से टूल्स चुने और क्यों?
3. डेटा में क्या कमियां थीं और आपने उन्हें कैसे संभाला?
4. आपके विश्लेषण से कंपनी को क्या ठोस फायदा हुआ?
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["1. Business context and core problem statement.","2. Tech stack selection rationale.","3. Explicit trade-off made during data preparation or modeling.","4. Limitations of the data (what you wished you had).","5. Business impact and actionable recommendation."]
interview_questions.common_pitfalls: ["Claiming the dataset was 'perfect with zero errors' (shows lack of real data experience).","Focusing 100% on code syntax without mentioning the business outcome.","Fabricating fake statistics or claiming they single-handedly made millions of dollars."]
interview_questions.detailed_explanation: Hiring managers look for self-awareness, honesty about data messy realities, and clear business alignment.

interview_questions.question_en: Tell me about a time when a stakeholder strongly disagreed with your data findings. How did you navigate the conversation without damaging the working relationship?
interview_questions.question_hi: उस समय के बारे में बताइए जब कोई सीनियर आपके डेटा निष्कर्षों से असहमत था। आपने रिश्ते खराब किए बिना स्थिति को कैसे संभाला? (STAR)
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
**Situation:**
In my previous role, our Sales Operations Director was convinced that our customer churn was driven entirely by our product pricing, because that's what prospects told sales reps on cancellation calls. My cohort analysis showed that churn was actually highest among customers who experienced two or more software crashes during onboarding, regardless of price tier.

**Task:**
I needed to present this reality without making the Sales Director feel defensive or invalidating his frontline experience.

**Action:**
Instead of broadcasting the findings in a large cross-functional meeting, I scheduled a private working session. I started by validating his perspective: "Sales feedback is our most valuable early warning signal." Then I walked him through the data side-by-side: "Let's filter our churned cohort by crash logs." We discovered that when the software worked smoothly, pricing complaints dropped by 80%. The customer mentioned price only because poor software reliability made them feel the price wasn't justified!

**Result:**
The Director became our biggest champion. He partnered with Engineering to prioritize onboarding stability. Within two quarters, onboarding crash rates dropped by 45% and churn decreased by 9%.
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
**STAR पद्धति से जवाब:**
- **Situation:** सेल्स डायरेक्टर को लगता था कि ग्राहक अधिक कीमत की वजह से छोड़ रहे हैं, जबकि डेटा दिखा रहा था कि सॉफ्टवेयर क्रैश असली वजह थी।
- **Task:** डायरेक्टर को नीचा दिखाए बिना सच्चाई सामने लाना।
- **Action:** मैंने अलग से बैठकर उनकी बात सुनी और उनके साथ मिलकर डेटा को फिल्टर किया। उन्हें दिखाया कि जब सॉफ्टवेयर सही चलता है तो ग्राहक कीमत की शिकायत नहीं करते।
- **Result:** डायरेक्टर ने हमारी रिपोर्ट को माना, इंजीनियरिंग टीम ने बग्स ठीक किए और ग्राहक छोड़ने की दर 9% घट गई।
interview_questions.skill_assessed: Handling Stakeholder Disagreement with Data (STAR Method)
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["1. Situation: Set up the context and the conflicting perspective.","2. Task: Your responsibility as an objective data advocate.","3. Action: Listening first, validating their domain intuition, co-investigating the data together.","4. Result: Mutual agreement, data-backed consensus, and strengthened trust."]
interview_questions.common_pitfalls: ["Sounding arrogant or dismissive of non-technical stakeholders ('They just didn't understand statistics').","Backing down immediately and altering data findings to please a boss.","Failing to show empathy for qualitative frontline business feedback."]
interview_questions.detailed_explanation: Data analysts are change agents. You must balance analytical integrity with diplomatic collaboration.

interview_questions.question_en: What are the most impactful, high-signal questions an entry-level Data Analyst candidate can ask their interviewers?
interview_questions.question_hi: इंटरव्यू के अंत में एक कैंडिडेट को इंटरव्यूअर से कौन से बेहतरीन सवाल पूछने चाहिए?
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
At the end of an interview, asking thoughtful questions proves strategic maturity. Here are five top-tier questions:

1. **On Decision Making:**
   *"Can you share an example of an analytical insight an analyst on your team generated recently that directly altered an executive or product decision?"*
   *(Reveals whether the team is genuinely data-driven or merely a 'ticket-taking report factory').*

2. **On Data Stack & Infrastructure:**
   *"What does the current data pipeline look like between raw ingestion and the analytical warehouse? How much time does an analyst spend cleaning upstream data vs driving strategic exploration?"*

3. **On Metric Alignment:**
   *"What is the single most critical KPI your team is trying to move this upcoming quarter, and where is the biggest bottleneck to moving it?"*

4. **On Mentorship & Culture:**
   *"How are code reviews, SQL query optimizations, and dashboard design critiques handled within the analytics team?"*

5. **On 90-Day Success:**
   *"If I am hired, what would success look like at the end of my first 90 days?"*
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
**इंटरव्यूअर से पूछने योग्य शानदार सवाल:**
1. "आपकी टीम द्वारा तैयार की गई हालिया रिपोर्ट से कंपनी का कौन सा बड़ा फैसला बदला?"
2. "एक एनालिस्ट का कितना समय डेटा क्लीनिंग में और कितना समय रणनीतिक इनसाइट्स निकालने में जाता है?"
3. "यदि मैं चुना जाता हूँ, तो पहले 90 दिनों में मेरी सफलता को आप कैसे मापेंगे?"
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["1. Questions about Data Stack & Maturity.","2. Questions about Business Impact & Decision Operationalization.","3. Questions about Mentorship & Growth.","4. Questions about Team Bottlenecks."]
interview_questions.common_pitfalls: ["Saying 'I don't have any questions, you answered everything' (signals lack of interest).","Only asking about vacation days, snacks, or salary during technical rounds.","Asking questions whose answers are clearly displayed on the homepage."]
interview_questions.detailed_explanation: Interviews are a two-way evaluation. Asking strategic questions signals that you care about making an impact.

interview_questions.question_en: What is the difference between WHERE and HAVING in SQL, and can you write a query demonstrating both?
interview_questions.question_hi: SQL में WHERE और HAVING में क्या अंतर है? दोनों का एक उदाहरण दीजिए।
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
**Key Difference:**
1. `WHERE` filters individual records *before* any grouping or aggregation takes place. It cannot evaluate aggregate functions like `SUM()` or `AVG()`.
2. `HAVING` filters aggregated groups *after* the `GROUP BY` clause has collapsed rows.

**Example Query:**
Find customer cities with more than 3 completed orders, but only considering orders placed in 2024:

```sql
SELECT c.city, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS city_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' -- Row-level filter BEFORE grouping
GROUP BY c.city
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 3;       -- Group-level filter AFTER aggregation
```
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
**मुख्य अंतर:**
1. `WHERE` ग्रुप बनने से *पहले* सिंगल रो को फिल्टर करता है। इसमें आप `SUM()` या `COUNT()` नहीं लगा सकते।
2. `HAVING` ग्रुप बनने के *बाद* कुल योग या गिनती पर फिल्टर लगाता है।

**उदाहरण:**
```sql
SELECT city, COUNT(order_id) 
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01'  -- पहले 2024 के ऑर्डर्स छांटे
GROUP BY city
HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 10;      -- फिर वही शहर दिखाए जहाँ 10 से ज्यादा ऑर्डर हैं
```
key_points: Explicitly mention execution order: FROM -> WHERE -> GROUP BY -> HAVING -> SELECT -> ORDER BY
Mention that WHERE filters rows, HAVING filters groups
Provide a clean code snippet with both clauses
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["Clarify business requirements","Explain reasoning & formula/code logic","State solution and business impact"]

interview_questions.question_en: Explain the difference between ROW_NUMBER(), RANK(), and DENSE_RANK() with a concrete example.
interview_questions.question_hi: ROW_NUMBER(), RANK() और DENSE_RANK() में क्या अंतर है? उदाहरण देकर समझाएं।
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
All three are SQL Window Functions used to rank records within a partition, but they handle ties (identical values) differently:

1. **ROW_NUMBER()**: Always assigns a strictly unique sequential integer (1, 2, 3, 4...). Never produces ties, regardless of identical values.
2. **RANK()**: Assigns identical ranks to tied rows, but **skips** subsequent ranks to account for the tie (e.g. 1, 2, 2, 4).
3. **DENSE_RANK()**: Assigns identical ranks to tied rows, but **never skips** numbers (e.g. 1, 2, 2, 3).

**Concrete Example (Salaries: 90K, 80K, 80K, 70K):**
- `ROW_NUMBER()`: 1, 2, 3, 4
- `RANK()`: 1, 2, 2, 4 (rank 3 is skipped)
- `DENSE_RANK()`: 1, 2, 2, 3 (no gap in sequence)

*Analyst Note:* If a stakeholder asks for the "Top 3 highest paid salary tiers", you must use `DENSE_RANK()`. If you use `RANK()`, the tie might push your 3rd tier into 4th place!
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
ये तीनों विंडो फंक्शन्स रैंकिंग देने के काम आते हैं, लेकिन जब दो लोगों के नंबर बराबर (Tie) हों तो इनका बर्ताव अलग होता है:

1. **ROW_NUMBER()**: हर रो को अलग नंबर देता है (1, 2, 3, 4)। कभी टाई नहीं करता।
2. **RANK()**: टाई होने पर बराबर रैंक देता है, लेकिन अगला नंबर छोड़ (Skip) देता है (जैसे 1, 2, 2, 4)।
3. **DENSE_RANK()**: टाई होने पर बराबर रैंक देता है, और बीच में कोई नंबर स्किप नहीं करता (जैसे 1, 2, 2, 3)।
key_points: Connect to real business scenario (e.g. Top 3 compensation brackets)
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["Clarify business requirements","Explain reasoning & formula/code logic","State solution and business impact"]

interview_questions.question_en: Tell me about a time a stakeholder asked for a metric that you knew was misleading or flawed. How did you handle it?
interview_questions.question_hi: अगर आपका मैनेजर कोई ऐसा मीट्रिक मांगे जो आपको पता है कि गलत तस्वीर दिखा रहा है, तो आप स्थिति को कैसे संभालेंगे? (STAR Method)
interview_questions.model_answer_en:
**Use the STAR Method (Situation, Task, Action, Result):**

- **Situation:** At my previous retail project, the Marketing VP noticed average order value (AOV) had jumped 35% and wanted to declare the holiday campaign a massive success in the board deck.
- **Task:** As the analyst, I inspected the underlying distribution and discovered the median order value had actually dropped by 12%. The mean was artificially inflated by just three massive corporate bulk orders.
- **Action:** Instead of confronting the VP in public or bluntly saying "you are wrong", I scheduled a 15-minute 1-on-1. I visualized the distribution using a boxplot comparing the bulk corporate segment with the general consumer segment. I explained that while overall revenue was healthy, our consumer conversion was softening. I proposed reporting both: celebrating the enterprise windfall while introducing a median-based consumer health tracker.
- **Result:** The VP appreciated the proactive safeguard, presented both metrics to the board, and we launched a targeted consumer retention campaign that saved ₹18 Lakhs in potential churn.
interview_questions.model_answer_hi:
**STAR मेथड से जवाब:**
- **Situation (परिस्थिति):** हमारे मैनेजर ने देखा कि औसत ऑर्डर वैल्यू (Mean) बढ़ गई है और वो इसे बड़ी जीत समझ रहे थे।
- **Task (काम):** मैंने डेटा की गहराई जांची और पाया कि सिर्फ 2 बहुत बड़े कॉरपोरेट ऑर्डर्स की वजह से औसत उछला था, जबकि 80% आम ग्राहकों की खरीद कम हो गई थी।
- **Action (कदम):** मैंने सीधे मना करने के बजाय प्यार से एक विज़ुअल चार्ट दिखाया जिसमें आम ग्राहक और कॉरपोरेट ग्राहक अलग-अलग थे। मैंने दोनों बातें सामने रखीं।
- **Result (नतीजा):** मैनेजर ने मेरी ईमानदारी की तारीफ की और हमने आम ग्राहकों के लिए स्पेशल डिस्काउंट प्लान बनाया जिससे कंपनी का बड़ा नुकसान होने से बच गया।
key_points: Structure using Situation, Task, Action, Result
Show diplomacy and empathy towards business leaders
Propose constructive dual metrics rather than just saying no
interview_questions.answer_structure: ["Clarify business requirements","Explain reasoning & formula/code logic","State solution and business impact"]

lessons.title: Environment Setup: Windows & macOS, Terminals, VS Code, Python & Virtual Environments
lessons.title_hi: डेटा एनालिस्ट कंप्यूटर सेटअप: विंडोज और मैक, टर्मिनल, VS Code, पायथन और venv
lessons.content_en:
### Preparing Your Computer for Professional Data Analysis

Before writing a single line of SQL or Python, every professional Data Analyst must know how to control their operating system, manage project directories, install runtimes safely, and troubleshoot environment collisions.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Verified against Official Documentation (Checked: October 2026)**
> Sources: [Python.org Official Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/using/index.html) | [VS Code Python Setup Guide](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/python/python-tutorial) | [DBeaver Official Guide](https://dbeaver.io/docs/)

---

### Part 1: Terminal & File System Foundations (Windows vs. macOS)

Your computer executes commands through a shell interface. 

#### Understanding Operating System Differences
| Task | Windows (PowerShell) | macOS (zsh Terminal) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Default Shell** | PowerShell 7 / Windows Terminal | zsh (Z Shell) |
| **Path Separator** | Backslash (`\`, e.g. `C:\Users\name\data`) | Forward slash (`/`, e.g. `/Users/name/data`) |
| **Current Directory** | `Get-Location` or `pwd` | `pwd` |
| **List Files** | `dir` or `ls` | `ls -la` (shows hidden files) |
| **Change Directory** | `cd folder_name` | `cd folder_name` |
| **Create Folder** | `mkdir my_project` | `mkdir my_project` |
| **Check Environment PATH** | `$env:PATH` | `echo $PATH` |

#### Working Directories & File Paths
- **Relative Path**: References a file relative to where your terminal currently sits (e.g. `data/sales.csv`).
- **Absolute Path**: The full path starting from the root drive (e.g. `C:\Projects\analyst\data\sales.csv` or `/Users/alex/projects/analyst/data/sales.csv`).
*Rule of thumb*: Always launch your terminal inside your project root so relative paths work seamlessly.

---

### Part 2: Installing Python 3.12+ Cleanly

#### A. Windows Installation Instructions
1. Download the latest stable 64-bit Windows installer from [python.org/downloads](https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/).
2. **CRITICAL STEP**: On the first installer screen, check the checkbox:  
   ☑️ **"Add python.exe to PATH"**  
   *(If you miss this checkbox, typing 'python' in terminal will fail with 'python is not recognized').*
3. Choose **Customize installation**, ensure `pip` and `py launcher` are selected, and click **Install**.
4. On the final screen, click **"Disable path length limit"** (allows Windows to open deeply nested data files).
5. Open a fresh PowerShell window and verify:
   ```powershell
   python --version
   pip --version
   ```

#### B. macOS Installation Instructions
macOS ships with a system stub for Python that you should *never* modify for projects.
- **Method 1 (Recommended Official Installer)**: Download the macOS 64-bit universal2 installer from [python.org/downloads/macos](https://www.python.org/downloads/macos/). Run the PKG installer. In the resulting Applications folder, double-click **"Install Certificates.command"** (essential for SSL/HTTPS data downloads).
- **Method 2 (Homebrew Package Manager)**:
  ```bash
  # If Homebrew is installed:
  brew install python@3.12
  ```
- Verify in Terminal:
  ```bash
  python3 --version
  pip3 --version
  ```

---

### Part 3: Installing & Configuring Visual Studio Code

Visual Studio Code (VS Code) is the industry standard lightweight code editor for data analysis.

1. **Download & Install**:
   - **Windows**: Download the 64-bit User Installer from [code.visualstudio.com](https://code.visualstudio.com/). Check the options for *"Add 'Open with Code' action to Windows Explorer context menu"*.
   - **macOS**: Download the ZIP, unzip it, and drag `Visual Studio Code.app` into your `/Applications` folder.
2. **Install the Essential Extensions**:
   - Open VS Code. Press `Ctrl+Shift+X` (Win) or `Cmd+Shift+X` (Mac) to open the Extensions tab.
   - Install:
     - **Python** (by Microsoft - includes Pylance, debugger, and environment switcher)
     - **Jupyter** (by Microsoft - allows interactive notebook cells inside VS Code)
     - **Excel Viewer** / **Rainbow CSV** (for inspecting CSV and TSV files visually)

---

### Part 4: Virtual Environments (`venv`) & Package Management (`pip`)

Why use a virtual environment? If Project A requires `pandas 2.0` and Project B requires `pandas 1.5`, installing them globally creates library collisions. A virtual environment isolates project dependencies inside a local hidden folder.

#### 1. Create a Project Folder & Virtual Environment
Open your terminal in your preferred directory:
```bash
mkdir data_analyst_sandbox
cd data_analyst_sandbox
python -m venv .venv
# On macOS if 'python' points to Python 2:
python3 -m venv .venv
```

#### 2. Activate the Virtual Environment
- **On Windows (PowerShell)**:
  ```powershell
  .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
  ```
  *(If you see 'execution of scripts is disabled on this system', run: `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass` and try again).*
- **On macOS / Linux (zsh or bash)**:
  ```bash
  source .venv/bin/activate
  ```
When activated, your terminal prompt will prefix with `(.venv)`.

#### 3. Select the Interpreter in VS Code
1. Open the project folder in VS Code: `code .`
2. Open the Command Palette: `Ctrl+Shift+P` (Win) or `Cmd+Shift+P` (Mac).
3. Type: `Python: Select Interpreter`.
4. Choose the interpreter labeled **('venv': .venv)** pointing to `.venv/Scripts/python.exe` or `.venv/bin/python`.

#### 4. Installing Core Data Analyst Libraries
With your virtual environment active:
```bash
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install pandas numpy matplotlib seaborn jupyter openpyxl
```
To save your exact project dependencies for reproducible sharing:
```bash
pip freeze > requirements.txt
```
To install dependencies from a requirements file on another machine:
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

---

### Part 5: Database Clients (DBeaver Community)

As a Data Analyst, you will frequently connect to databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Snowflake). 
- Download **DBeaver Community Edition** (free, open-source, cross-platform for Windows and macOS) from [dbeaver.io/download](https://dbeaver.io/download/).
- To connect to a local SQLite database (like this platform's `analystpath.db`):
  1. Click **Database > New Database Connection**.
  2. Select **SQLite** and click Next.
  3. Browse to your `.db` file path and click **Finish**.
  4. You can now visually browse tables, inspect column schemas, and execute SQL scripts with full autocompletion.

---

### Part 6: Comprehensive Troubleshooting Matrix

| Symptom / Error | Root Cause | Exact Solution |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `'python' is not recognized as an internal or external command` | Python was not added to the Windows PATH environment variable. | Re-run the Python installer, select 'Modify', check 'Add to PATH'. Or search Windows 'Edit system environment variables' -> Path -> Add `C:\Users\<User>\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312\`. |
| `File Activate.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled` | Windows PowerShell default security execution policy restricts scripts. | Run: `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass` in your PowerShell session, then re-run `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`. |
| `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pandas'` | The active VS Code interpreter is different from the environment where pip installed the library. | Press `Ctrl+Shift+P` / `Cmd+Shift+P` -> `Python: Select Interpreter` -> pick your `.venv` interpreter. |
| `SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED` on macOS when downloading data | Python on macOS does not use the system keychain certificates by default. | Open Finder -> Applications -> Python 3.12 -> double click **"Install Certificates.command"**. |
lessons.content_hi:
### डेटा एनालिसिस के लिए अपने कंप्यूटर को सही तरीके से तैयार करें

डेटा एनालिसिस सीखने का सबसे पहला और जरूरी कदम है अपने लैपटॉप पर सही टूल्स इंस्टॉल करना ताकि आगे चलकर कभी "कमांड नहीं मिला" या "पैकेज एरर" ना आए।

---

### 1. ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम का अंतर समझें (Windows vs. macOS)
- **Windows**: इसमें हम **PowerShell** का इस्तेमाल करते हैं। फोल्डर पाथ में बैकस्लैश (`\`) लगता है (जैसे: `C:\Users\Alex\Data`)।
- **macOS**: इसमें हम **Terminal (zsh)** का इस्तेमाल करते हैं। फोल्डर पाथ में फॉरवर्ड स्लैश (`/`) लगता है (जैसे: `/Users/Alex/Data`)।
- फोल्डर बदलने का कमांड दोनों में समान है: `cd folder_name`।
- फाइल्स देखने के लिए Windows में `dir` और Mac पर `ls` चलता है।

---

### 2. पायथन (Python 3.12+) इंस्टॉल करना
#### Windows पर:
1. [python.org](https://www.python.org/downloads/) से 64-bit इंस्टॉलर डाउनलोड करें।
2. **सबसे जरूरी बात**: पहली ही स्क्रीन पर नीचे दिए गए चेकबॉक्स पर टिक लगाएं:  
   ☑️ **"Add python.exe to PATH"**  
   *(अगर यह छोड़ दिया, तो टर्मिनल में पायथन नहीं चलेगा!)*
3. इंस्टॉल खत्म होने पर **"Disable path length limit"** पर क्लिक करें।

#### macOS पर:
- [python.org/downloads/macos](https://www.python.org/downloads/macos/) से PKG फाइल डाउनलोड करके इंस्टॉल करें।
- Applications में जाकर **"Install Certificates.command"** पर डबल-क्लिक जरूर करें, ताकि इंटरनेट से डेटा डाउनलोड करते समय SSL एरर ना आए।

---

### 3. VS Code और वर्चुअल एनवायरनमेंट (venv)
कंपनी में हर प्रोजेक्ट के लिए अलग वर्चुअल एनवायरनमेंट बनाया जाता है ताकि लाइब्रेरी आपस में ना टकराएं।

```bash
# 1. नया फोल्डर बनाएं और उसमें जाएं
mkdir my_data_project
cd my_data_project

# 2. वर्चुअल एनवायरनमेंट बनाएं
python -m venv .venv

# 3. एक्टिवेट करें
# Windows PowerShell पर:
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
# Mac Terminal पर:
source .venv/bin/activate
```

जब टर्मिनल में आगे `(.venv)` दिखने लगे, तो जरूरी लाइब्रेरीज इंस्टॉल करें:
```bash
pip install pandas numpy matplotlib jupyter
```

---

### 4. आम गलतियां और समाधान
1. **'python' is not recognized**: इंस्टॉलर चलाते समय "Add to PATH" भूल गए थे। इंस्टॉलर दोबारा चलाकर Modify करें और टिक लगाएं।
2. **Activate.ps1 script execution error**: PowerShell में टाइप करें:  
   `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass`
3. **ModuleNotFoundError**: VS Code में `Ctrl+Shift+P` दबाएं, 'Python: Select Interpreter' चुनें और अपना `.venv` इंटरप्रेटर सेलेक्ट करें।

common_mistakes.mistake: Installing all packages into the global root Python installation without a virtual environment
common_mistakes.consequence: Eventually conflicting package versions break existing scripts and make it impossible to share code reliably with team members.
common_mistakes.fix: Always create a local '.venv' inside every project directory before running pip install.

common_mistakes.mistake: Committing the entire '.venv' folder (hundreds of megabytes) to GitHub
common_mistakes.consequence: Bloats the Git repository with platform-specific binaries that will fail on teammates' operating systems.
common_mistakes.fix: Add '.venv/' to your '.gitignore' file and commit 'requirements.txt' instead.

lesson_test.explanation: Adding Python to PATH registers the python binary directory in the OS system environment variables, allowing your terminal to execute 'python' from any folder.

lessons.title: Pandas DataFrames, Filtering, Grouping & Business EDA
lessons.title_hi: पैंडास डेटाफ्रेम, फिल्टरिंग, ग्रुपबाय और एक्सप्लोरेटरी डेटा एनालिसिस (EDA)
lessons.content_en:
### Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with Pandas

Pandas is the premier library for tabular data manipulation in Python. In this lesson, we cover loading data, profiling structure, filtering conditional subsets, and aggregating business metrics.

> [!NOTE]
> Verified against **Pandas 2.2+ Official API Specification** (Checked: October 2026).

---

### 1. Reading & Initial Inspection
```python
import pandas as pd

# Load CSV
df = pd.read_csv('orders.csv', parse_dates=['order_date'])

# Fundamental profiling methods:
print(df.shape)         # Returns (rows, columns) tuple, e.g. (10000, 9)
print(df.info())          # Data types, non-null counts, memory footprint
print(df.describe())      # Count, mean, std, min, 25%, 50%, 75%, max
print(df.head(5))         # Inspect first 5 rows
print(df.isnull().sum())  # Count missing values per column
```

---

### 2. Boolean Filtering & Slicing
In Pandas, filtering uses boolean masks. Always wrap multiple conditions in parentheses and use bitwise operators (`&` for AND, `|` for OR):

```python
# Filter orders above ₹10,000 shipped to South or West region
high_value_mask = (df['total_amount'] >= 10000) & (df['shipping_region'].isin(['South', 'West']))
filtered_df = df[high_value_mask]

# Selecting specific columns
summary = filtered_df[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'total_amount', 'shipping_region']]
```

---

### 3. Aggregations with `.groupby()`
Groupby allows splitting data by categories, applying aggregations, and combining the results:

```python
# High-performance named aggregation
regional_performance = df.groupby('shipping_region').agg(
    total_revenue=('total_amount', 'sum'),
    average_order_value=('total_amount', 'mean'),
    total_orders=('order_id', 'count'),
    active_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique')
).sort_values(by='total_revenue', ascending=False).reset_index()

# Add a calculated KPI column
regional_performance['revenue_per_customer'] = (
    regional_performance['total_revenue'] / regional_performance['active_customers']
).round(2)

print(regional_performance)
```

---

### 4. Handling Missing Data
- **Drop**: `df.dropna(subset=['critical_column'])`
- **Impute**: `df['satisfaction_score'].fillna(df['satisfaction_score'].median(), inplace=True)`
lessons.content_hi:
### पैंडास (Pandas) से डेटा एनालिसिस और रिपोर्टिंग

पैंडास डेटा एनालिस्ट्स का सबसे मुख्य हथियार है। यह एक्सेल से लाखों गुना तेजी से लाखों पंक्तियों का हिसाब-किताब लगा सकता है।

---

### 1. डेटा लोड करना और प्रोफाइलिंग
```python
import pandas as pd

# CSV फाइल लोड करें
df = pd.read_csv('orders.csv')

# डेटा का ढांचा देखें
print(df.shape)        # कितनी पंक्तियां और कॉलम हैं
print(df.info())         # कॉलम के डेटा टाइप्स और मिसिंग वैल्यूज
print(df.describe())     # औसत, न्यूनतम, अधिकतम और मीडियन
```

---

### 2. डेटा फिल्टर करना (Boolean Indexing)
जब एक से ज्यादा शर्तें हों, तो हर शर्त को ब्रैकेट `()` में रखें और `&` (AND) या `|` (OR) लगाएं:
```python
# 10,000 से ज्यादा अमाउंट और साउथ रीजन के ऑर्डर्स
shart = (df['total_amount'] > 10000) & (df['shipping_region'] == 'South')
result = df[shart]
```

---

### 3. GroupBy: रीजन और डिपार्टमेंट वाइज टोटल निकालना
```python
# हर रीजन की कुल सेल्स और ऑर्डर्स की संख्या
report = df.groupby('shipping_region').agg(
    total_sales=('total_amount', 'sum'),
    avg_order=('total_amount', 'mean'),
    order_count=('order_id', 'count')
).reset_index()

print(report)
```

worked_examples.title: Calculating Customer Retention Cohorts
worked_examples.problem: Given orders dataset, find total spend and order frequency for each customer, flagging those with >3 orders as 'Loyal'.
worked_examples.query:
cust_summary = df.groupby('customer_id').agg(
    total_spend=('total_amount', 'sum'),
    order_count=('order_id', 'count')
).reset_index()

cust_summary['segment'] = cust_summary['order_count'].apply(
    lambda x: 'Loyal' if x >= 3 else 'Occasional'
)
worked_examples.explanation_en: Using .apply() with a lambda or numpy.where assigns dynamic segment labels based on aggregated behavior.

common_mistakes.mistake: Writing a Python 'for row in df.iterrows()' loop to calculate a column
common_mistakes.consequence: Slows execution down by 100x to 1000x on large datasets; defeats the purpose of Pandas vectorization.
common_mistakes.fix: Use vectorized column operations: df['discounted_price'] = df['price'] * (1 - df['discount_pct']).
